verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into a stacked Hemorrhage bleed or walk into Apprehend before level 6; you win if you dodge his E, bait Decimate's wind-up, and carry the fight past your first back with Stridebreaker online.

brief.thesis: Darius wins short trades because every Hemorrhage stack adds bleed damage and his passive armor shred on Apprehend makes Garen's flat spin damage fall off fast, while his E pull denies the one tool (Q's gap-close) Garen has to force a fight on his own terms. That's why Garen sits at 41.7% over 242 games here even though he's a 50.4% champion overall — this is a lane you survive with wave control and Health Potion sustain until items even the fight out.

theirWindow.what: He'll walk up baiting a trade, then hook you in with Apprehend for a free auto and Hemorrhage stack before you can react. Don't extend trades while his E is up, especially levels 1-6 when it's only 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s.

yourWindow.when: right after he whiffs or uses Apprehend
yourWindow.what: Use Q (Decisive Strike) to close the gap free of any slow, land the silence, then chain W (Courage) and E (Judgment) for your two damage-around-you casts back to back. He has nothing to disengage with for the next 16-26s.

start.why: The passive damage reduction and health regen directly offset early Decimate pokes and the constant Hemorrhage bleed tick — this is the pick 53.9% of Garens take into this exact matchup.

boots.why: Most-picked at 66.8%; the attack speed lets you land more Judgment ticks and stack your own trades faster before Darius's bleed outpaces you.

core.why: The active slow is your answer to Darius disengaging with Crippling Strike or walking you down — you can't out-trade him without first being able to stick.
Attack speed and move speed keep you in range to finish trades once Stridebreaker has closed the gap.
Grievous Wounds cuts the healing Darius gets from Decimate's blade edge, which is a big chunk of why he wins extended fights.

situational.when: he's healing off Decimate blade hits early and you need the Grievous Wounds before Mortal Reminder completes
you need more raw health to survive his all-in past level 6 rather than pure damage
he's playing passively and kiting — you need the extra active haste to run him down

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking damage and healing rewards the longer trades you're forced into once you've dodged his E, directly offsetting the Hemorrhage bleed ticking on you.

summoners.why: Run at 90.6% pick rate here — Ignite makes up the raw damage deficit against Darius's healing and bleed, and it secures kills once Demacian Justice brings him low.

playing.title: Never fight at five stacks
playing.detail: Once Hemorrhage hits max stacks Darius enrages and his attack damage spikes hard. Disengage before you let a trade run that long.

playing.title: Bait Apprehend before committing
playing.detail: Walk to the edge of his 535 range and watch for the wind-up. If he whiffs E, that's your 16-26s window to all-in with Q into W and E.

playing.title: Side-step the blade edge of Decimate
playing.detail: Enemies hit by Decimate's blade take far more damage than those hit by the handle, and it heals him on champion hits. Stand at the edge of his swing radius during his wind-up.

playing.title: Use Q's silence to shut down his all-in
playing.detail: Decisive Strike's next attack silences — land it on Darius right before he'd otherwise cast Noxian Guillotine at low health to deny the execute.

playing.title: Freeze the wave near your tower
playing.detail: Since this is a defensive matchup, deny him easy trade windows by holding the wave close to your turret rather than fighting him in the open river-side of the lane.

playing.title: Play for the level 11-13 spike
playing.detail: Once Stridebreaker completes, its slow finally lets you stick to him — this is when the lane stops being purely defensive and starts being winnable.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade timing, cooldown windows, and lane-management reasoning are my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Bring Ignite when facing Darius to make up for your damage. Avoid being pulled in by his (E) and fight him when his abilities are on cooldown.
